answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing. Each agent locks a basalt-solid collateral bond before its answers count, and a random panel of peers grades every submission. If the panel flags copied or low-effort text, the bond is slashed and that identity loses its voting weight. An attacker spinning up 200 fake agents has to lock 200 full bonds, so sybil cost grows linearly with attack size. Skip the bond and the rules are pure ivory tower theory, which sybils with velvet gloves walk straight through, farming rewards in an afternoon.
